verdict.rationale: Bland's voice agents can call any HTTP endpoint through the custom API tool and webhooks, but nothing in the evidence shows a voice agent plugging in external MCP servers as tool sources mid-call. The documented Bland MCP server is the opposite role: it lets coding agents manage a Bland account, so it does not count toward this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my voice agent can plug in MCP servers as tool sources so one integration grants it whole toolsets mid-call
